text.p: Cleanup continues along the Red River in the upper Plains of the USA and in southern Manitoba, Canada, near Winnepeg.

Tropical cyclone 01b has crossed the coast of Bangladesh and is now moving inland, to the north-northeast at 15 mph. Top winds have weakened to near 100 mph. Winds were near 130 mph at the time of landfall. Heavy rains and destructive winds are currently battering the region, especially at the immediate coast. Coastal areas can expect major flooding as a storm surge of up to 24 feet moves across the coastline. Very strong winds will also cause severe damage through coastal areas and inland. Very heavy rains further inland will lead to massive flooding and property damage, as well. Shipping in the northeast Bangladesh is still at risk due to very rough seas for the next 12-24 hours.
